title: MINSEQE: Minimum Information about a High-Throughput Sequencing Experiment
description: Checklist specifying minimal metadata for HTS experiments so results are interpretable and reproducible, including raw/processed data, protocols and sample-data relationships.
keyFeatures: Requires raw and processed data with provenance; Documents library prep, instruments and analysis steps; Links samples to datasets for full traceability
practicalUse: Include MINSEQE fields in protocols and publications to meet repository/journal expectations and support QA/QC.
